latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Instagram — a cloud-based tool for editing videos for Instagram Reels and Stories.

- Accepts raw video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and edits them via cloud GPU processing.
- Automatically handles authentication/session setup with free credits for new users.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 files optimized for Instagram.
- Supports cropping, text overlays, captioning, BGM, and common video edits through simple prompts.
- Clearly communicates upload, status, credits, and export steps in chat.
- Robust error handling for authentication, credits, file size/type, and export limits.
